# IRON VISION tools

> IRON VISION tools is a small team based in Edirne, Türkiye (since April 2026) that builds AI tools for businesses, from small shops to larger companies, and sets them up for the customer. Customer data stays with the customer. The site is in Turkish (https://ironvisiontools.com/) and English (https://ironvisiontools.com/en/).

## Products (as described on the site)
- WhatsApp appointment bot: customers book through WhatsApp, see open slots and get an appointment; no app download or site sign-up. Overnight requests are summarized in one morning message; the owner blocks hours and sets rules from a panel and can step into the chat at any time. First 10 days free; pilot region is Edirne.
- VYRON AgentOS: automation system that takes over repetitive work (inbox scanning, daily summary, backups and verification, cost tracking, watchdogs, scheduled jobs, Telegram commands, browser automation). Installed per business, set-up takes 2-4 weeks.
- Sesli Şef: voice interface for the system.
- MoyMote: Windows app to control an external monitor's brightness, blue light and HDR from a phone (https://moymote.com, Microsoft Store). 7-day free trial.
- Try-On: listed on the site as a product (see the site for status).
